label: Bible Study
prompt: And on the seventh day God ended his work which he had made; and he _____ on the seventh day from all his work which he had made.
verse: And on the seventh day God ended his work which he had made; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had made.
note: The first sabbath — God rests on day seven, not from weariness but because the work was finished.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Nevertheless he left not himself without witness, in that he did good, and gave us _____ from heaven, and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness.
verse: Nevertheless he left not himself without witness, in that he did good, and gave us rain from heaven, and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness.
note: Paul tells a crowd in Lystra that rain, harvests, and full bellies are God's calling cards.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Ye see how _____ a letter I have written unto you with mine own hand.
verse: Ye see how large a letter I have written unto you with mine own hand.
note: Near the end of Galatians, Paul takes up the pen himself — 'how large a letter I have written... with mine own hand.'

label: Deep Water
prompt: And how shall they preach, except they be sent? as it is written, How _____ are the feet of them that preach the gospel of peace, and bring glad tidings of good things!
verse: And how shall they preach, except they be sent? as it is written, How beautiful are the feet of them that preach the gospel of peace, and bring glad tidings of good things!
note: Paul quotes Isaiah 52:7 — even dusty feet look lovely when they're carrying good news.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: For who will hearken unto you in this matter? but as his part is that goeth down to the battle, so shall his part be that _____ by the stuff: they shall part alike.
verse: For who will hearken unto you in this matter? but as his part is that goeth down to the battle, so shall his part be that tarrieth by the stuff: they shall part alike.
note: David's rule after Ziklag: those who guard the supplies share equally with those who fight. Every church's behind-the-scenes verse.
